run.method: independent naming form-saturation wave D: recoverable blend, code-token, and citation-architecture matrix
run.brief: Generate raw observations only; preserve affirmative, ambivalent, adverse, wildcard, and overlap-prone forms without ranking, selection, availability checks, or repair.
notes: Audit source: identity/reports/saturation-form-audit.md SHA-256 06831eef17c05a5faffcc1cb0376a5da838bd3fb5a5db907b7fd398ce2814ef7.

Isolation record: product implementation/docs, atlas, schema, prompt, and assigned matrix cells were read before ideation; no candidate inbox surface, registry, enrichment, score, or wave C output was read before these surfaces were frozen.

Cell boundaries: 1-10 true blends; 11-20 code tokens; 21-30 eponym and citation architecture. Each cell has two wildcards, five affirmative, three ambivalent, two adverse records, and scope counts current 4, horizon 4, both 2.

No parent run is asserted because this is an independent generation lineage. All code projections are morphology-only and unvalidated; none is an availability, collision, package-publication, or selection claim.

Post-freeze mechanical registry comparison against the rebuilt accepted registry (1,864 candidate IDs; this run excluded) found retained overlaps: Modulect (cand-2669a117150016d2), A-B (cand-fb8e20fc2e4c3f24), !Eval (cand-1bbd174404efbce9), Ariadne Thread (cand-d16fcb644b1bc984). No surface was replaced.
